name: terminal-portfolio
description: Personal site as a fake terminal — commands, easter eggs, themes and a prerendered CV — driven by one profile.config.ts.
author: Nikita Chernozipunnikov

scripts.deploy: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && gh-pages -d dist --dotfiles -m 'deploy'
scripts.deploy:s3: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- sh scripts/deploy-s3.sh
scripts.deploy:s3:dry-run: npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- env DRY_RUN=1 sh scripts/deploy-s3.sh
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cf:dry-run: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
